channel.title: AI on the Clock — Bites
channel.description: One idea per post, in plain English. What a thing actually is, where it came from, and why it became infrastructure while nobody was looking.

item.title: What Is Shadow AI? Why Banning AI Tools Makes the Risk Worse
item.description: Employees are already using AI at work through personal accounts and browser extensions nobody approved. Banning it does not remove the risk — it removes your visibility of it.

item.title: What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? A Plain-English Guide
item.description: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for how AI applications connect to tools and data — the USB-C port for AI. What it is, where it came from, and why it became infrastructure in eighteen months.

item.title: 5 Hard Questions About Your AI Strategy
item.description: If you cannot answer these five, you do not have a strategy — you have a budget line and some enthusiasm.

item.title: The RISEN Framework: A Repeatable Way to Write Prompts
item.description: Role, Instructions, Steps, End goal, Narrowing — five slots that turn prompting from guesswork into something you can hand to a colleague.
